concerns.text: T001 omits the mandatory pre-download checksum verification required by FR-038 and Constitution Principle III. It only specifies verifying URLs and timestamps: 'verify all external dataset URLs... against official sources with timestamps'.

T006 fails to include a task for the acquisition or computation of 'matched-architecture control pairs' required by FR-010 to calculate the $\Delta$ similarity metric. The task assumes the baseline exists but does not task its creation.
T002 omits the numerical instability check for SVD (singular values < 1e-12) and the associated error-handling logic required by FR-033.
